gbl-battle-2026-10-20.description: First battle, recorded without ManGo. You: Altaria, Mimikyu, Melmetal. Opponent: Stunfisk, Cramorant, Fearow.

notes.1: Rounding to the nearest fast move had given 7; only finished fast moves count when they throw.
notes.7: Fearow came in after Cramorant fainted (both start at 0 turns). You threw 1 fast move then a charged move: both 2-turn moves lined up, so Fearow got 2 Pecks. You threw 2 more then a charged move: 3 more Pecks. Fearow threw 1 more Peck, then Drill Run. Fearow had shielded your Double Iron Bash, and your buttons came back late; since Drill Run can only start as a Peck finishes, ManGo works out that the battle restarted 0.6s before them.

gbl-battle-2026-10-20-mango.description: Second battle, with ManGo's overlay on screen (dragged to the bottom partway through). You: Altaria, Melmetal, Mimikyu. Opponent: Marowak, Sableye (Shadow), Talonflame.

notes.1: The countdown's GO read as "CO"; ManGo on the phone started late and showed 30 instead of 50.
notes.5: ManGo said 8 before freezing at your buttons vanishing rather than at "Get Ready!".

gbl-battle-2026-10-20-v2.description: Third battle, with ManGo's overlay on screen. You: Altaria, Melmetal, Mimikyu. Opponent: Melmetal, Ninetales (Shadow), Altaria (swapping Ninetales and Altaria).

notes.3: Thrown straight away with leftover energy. Melmetal then threw 3 Thunder Shocks and fainted to a fast move. Thrown as soon as the battle restarted, about when your buttons came back.
notes.4: Ninetales threw 2 Embers, you threw Dynamic Punch (both 2-turn moves, lined up) so 1 more slipped in, then 3 more with a 1-turn break between the 5th and 6th. ManGo can't see breaks, so it counts 7.
notes.6: Dragon Breath is too fast to count by eye.
notes.7: Dragon Breath is too fast to count by eye.

gbl-battle-2026-10-20-v3.description: Fourth battle, a Fantasy Cup with ManGo's overlay on screen (covering the opponent's name box much of the time). You: Altaria, Melmetal, Mimikyu. Opponent: Mimikyu, Turtonator, Granbull.

notes.1: Mimikyu led (named from the start's "Go, Mimikyu!") and threw 2 Shadow Claws before switching to Turtonator. Turtonator threw 5 Incinerates.
notes.2: Thrown straight after the first Dragon Claw, in the same stop. Turtonator then switched out to Granbull.
notes.3: Granbull switched in during the stop after Turtonator's Dragon Claws, so it starts as the battle restarts. 7 Charms before Crunch, then 1 that counted when your charged move interrupted it, then 5 that knocked out your Mimikyu and Altaria.

gbl-battle-2026-10-20-v7.description: Seventh battle, with ManGo on screen. Opponent: Azumarill, Empoleon, Magnezone.

notes.1: Empoleon used Waterfall (+10 every 3 turns), not PvPoke's Metal Sound, so ManGo overcounted it; not hand-counted.
notes.3: Includes Azumarill's 1 Bubble as the lead before switching out.

gbl-battle-2026-10-20-v8.description: Eighth battle, with ManGo on screen. Opponent: Azumarill, Lucario, Mawile.

notes.3: Includes Azumarill's 1 Bubble as the lead before switching out.
